lines.text: Five days after Hitler died, Americans and Germans fought on the same side.

parts.tts: Five days after Hitler died, Americans and Germans fought on the same side.
parts.heard: Five days after Hitler died, Americans and Germans fought on the same side.

parts.tts: May fifth, nineteen forty-five. Itter Castle, Austria.

lines.text: Inside: famous French prisoners, including two former prime ministers.

parts.tts: Inside: famous French prisoners, including two former prime ministers.
parts.heard: Inside, famous French prisoners, including two former prime ministers.

lines.text: Outside: Waffen-SS troops, coming to attack.

parts.tts: Outside: Waffen S.S. troops, coming to attack.
parts.heard: outside Waffen-SS troops coming to attack.

lines.text: Defending the castle? A small group of American tank soldiers...

parts.tts: Defending the castle? A small group of American tank soldiers...
parts.heard: defending the castle, a small group of American tank soldiers,

lines.text: German army soldiers who had joined the resistance...

parts.tts: German army soldiers who had joined the resistance...
parts.heard: German army soldiers who had joined the resistance.

lines.text: and the French prisoners themselves, picking up rifles.

parts.tts: and the French prisoners themselves, picking up rifles.
parts.heard: and the French prisoners themselves picking up rifles.

lines.text: But here's the part that sounds made up...

parts.tts: But here's the part that sounds made up...
parts.heard: But here's the part that sounds made up.

lines.text: The German commander, Major Sepp Gangl, was killed by a sniper while trying to get a former French prime minister out of the line of fire.

parts.tts: The German commander, Major Sepp Gangl, was killed by a sniper while trying to get a former French prime minister out of the line of fire.
parts.heard: The German commander, Major Sepp Gangl, was killed by a sniper while trying to get a former French prime minister out of the line of fire.

lines.text: The castle held until help arrived.

parts.tts: The castle held until help arrived.
parts.heard: The castle held until help arrived.

lines.text: It's one of only two known times in the war that Americans and Germans fought side by side.

parts.tts: It's one of only two known times in the war that Americans and Germans fought side by side.
